title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Case: Clear/Silicone $63.20, TechWoven $79.20 | FineWoven Wallet $79.20, Wrist Strap $36 @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Case: Clear/Silicone $63.20, TechWoven $79.20 | FineWoven Wallet $79.20, Wrist Strap $36 @ Amazon AU

[Shenannigoat] These will fit the 17 Pros as well
Edit: Apple doesn’t explicitly state they’re interchangeable. The dimensions are the same, though
[HansW] Yes they fit. My Black 18PM Techwoven case fits perfectly on my 17PM as well.
[Zuelly] I was thinking, do people seriously pay these prices; then I remember they are buying an iPhone 18 Pro on launch…
[CHWBCA] Yes I'm an irresponsible dummy but its better than spending it on drugs and hookers i guess
[Chuppa] While the upfront cost is high, the resale value makes a big difference. An iPhone 17 Pro Max gets a $1,500 trade-in at Optus without needing to buy a new device from them.
That works out to only $699 depreciation over a year, which is even lower if you bought it with discounted gift cards. It's hard to find another phone that holds its value that well.
[xsacha] Usually I buy a $2k Samsung for about $1200 with all their weird promos and then resell it for $1500 a year later and actually make a profit.
The thing I'm actually finding crazy is spending $80 on basic cases. I suppose the cost of the phone is making these accessory prices sound reasonable.
[Legend279] Ordered one yesterday at full price, looks like I’ll be returning it and ordering one at 20% off
[erd] Just ask for a refund of difference, saves everyone effort
[CHWBCA] I bought the TechWoven Black case and I'm not a fan. It has a very ruff plastic feel and is uncomfortable in the hands i thought it would of had a more softer texture. I've ordered a silicon case silicon case lesson learned
[thesainter] Yes i also find the tech woven to be rough and cheap ass feeling, 3rd party leather is the way.
[coxymla] How's the Apple Silicone cases?
I hear the TechWoven are not very good.
The third party cases for 18 Pro look like trash compared to previous years.
[HansW] FineWoven was trash. Techwoven is really good. They have a coating on top to prevent scratches stains liquids etc.
[thesainter] they are both trash, techwoven feels like cheap rough plastic
[Tanvry] I was wondering who had the gall to charge such prices for a case, then I realise it's apple themselves which now makes sense completely.
